subjects.request: Keep the same headless bare torso with its single healed diagonal chest scar. Replace the ENTIRE HAMMER with ONE proper HALLIGAN FORCIBLE-ENTRY BAR. The Halligan has ONE long stout straight steel shaft, a TWO-PRONGED FORK with a deep U-shaped gap at ONE end, and a compact ADZE-AND-PIKE HEAD at the OTHER end: one short broad flat adze blade projecting to one side and one short pointed spike projecting to the opposite side at the SAME junction. Complete unmistakable fork, shaft, adze and pike, broad simplified white silhouette. No hammer block, sledge head, axe blade, knife, gun, labels or fine machining. Exactly torso and Halligan bar, no extra prop, wound, blood, gore or detailed muscles.
